title: "F-CGKA — Continuous group key agreement"
status: "Emerging"
layer: 3

*F-CGKA* (Continuous group key agreement) is part of *Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: an emerging formulation, still an active area of research.

*References:*

- Alwen, Jost, and Mularczyk. [*On the insider security of MLS*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2020/1327). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2022, volume 13508 of LNCS, pages 34–68, 2022.
- Alwen et al. [*Security analysis and improvements for the IETF MLS standard for group messaging*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2019/1189). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2020, 2020.
